title: SR-1.06 One licence schema, validated everywhere
request: Closes G06: LICENSE_FIELDS omits trial, org and trial_ext that other modules read; installLicense skips the check activate applies. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Schema and both entry points
requirements: every field read anywhere is in the schema
install and activate run the same validator
the header comment matches what a licence may carry

installLicense refuses a licence carrying name, email or machine exactly as activateLicense does, and writes no file; the test installs such a licence from file and asserts the refusal (the twin measured install writing a licence that activate refuses: src/cli/licensing.mjs:148-151 never calls extraFields, :90 does)
a trial licence and an org licence install from file and activate by key under the same rule; the schema header states which non-identity fields (trial, org, trial_ext) a licence may carry

criteria.statement: A licence with an unknown field is refused by install and by activate
